summary: Mock impl matches spec: 25vh MatchHeader + 75vh three-panel 25/50/25 grid, body overflow hidden, no footer rendered in feature scope. Dynamic league theming via [data-league] tokens with components referencing only --theme-* (verified by grep). NS/FT/cancelled/error/loading states handled in view; 404 redirect via router.replace to not-found; default formation tab with URL ?tab= sync (delete on default). Mock layer uses import.meta.glob (eager) and falls back to 1000001 when per-id JSON absent; 1000099 → NotFoundError, 1000098 → ServerError. Vitest 27/27 PASS, Playwright 10/10 PASS (logs in /tmp). Production build succeeds; FixtureDetailView chunk = 38.71 kB JS / 10.50 kB CSS (matches reported).
